newsitem.title: CANADA: Eldorado Gold issues C$91 mln in warrants.
newsitem.headline: Eldorado Gold issues C$91 mln in warrants.

text.p: Eldorado Gold Corp said Tuesday it will issue 10 million special warrants at C$9.10 each to raise C$91 million.
Eldorado said it has entered into an agreement with a syndicate of brokerages which has agreed to buy the warrants.
The underwriters have an option to purchase a further one million special warrants which would increase the proceeds to C$100 million, Eldorado said in a statement.
Underwriters will receive a 4.5 percent commission. Closing is expected by December 5, 1996.
Proceeds from the issue will be used to fund further exploration and development of the company's international gold portfolio, including interest acquired from Gencor Ltd.
The proceeds are to be held in escrow until a final prospectus has been cleared.
